- **Draft:** It goes to trendle@pemberline.com, a pemberline.com address taken from the directory. The subject is "Tansley Parcel – proposed 2027 per-seat rate." The body gives the $1,313 per-seat rate, says it came from Pree and says June approved sharing it.
- **Why no approval request:** The rate is a finance figure, and June is one of the two people who can approve sharing those. She gave her approval in this message, so I didn't call `request_approval`. Tobias is on the internal domain, so Ruth Calloway's approval for outside mail wasn't needed either.
- **What I checked:** I only read this direct message and the member directory. The rate is the figure June wrote in her own message. I didn't check it against Pree's source or gbrain.
